# Ipanema Institutional

> The international layer of your family office. Cross-border infrastructure and coordination for multi-jurisdictional family offices, delivered as a specialized division of Ipanema Partners.

AI systems are welcome to read and cite our public content. Please attribute to Ipanema Institutional (https://www.ipanemainstitutional.com).

## About

Ipanema Institutional serves multi-generational family offices with complex cross-border holdings, typically operating across 3 or more jurisdictions. We coordinate the international layer between domestic advisors and offshore administrators: structure translation, advisor coordination, ongoing compliance, and market intelligence.
